title: Inflatable Airplanes
content: I've never referred to this dreaming space as the "Mall World" because the "Mall Aesthetic" only appears probably once every month or so and I'm usually at the top of the auditorium/plaza area. I have been outside of it. I've been outside of it a lot and have mapped it. I usually referred to it as the "Endless House" because if you leave the Mall area you will enter a series of rooms that connect to more rooms but pretty much go nowhere, unless one of the doors I've spotted leads to the outside. The "outside" feels like the collective imagination, or collective consciousness remembering what reality is. So you have landmarks such as stores, gas-stations, schools, and houses but they are all... weird. It is as if the world was built by through memory. If you asked a child to draw a picture of their home and then took that drawing and made it physical, that's how it would come across. They are familiar, but not familiar. Things are all connected. Everything leads to everything. There's highways, bridges, and roads everywhere but sometimes the roads do loop-de-loops or just have no real sense behind their creation. I remember one time heading into this futuristic city and the road was laying right on the river's water. Not floating or suspended, just stitched in, if that makes sense. As if someone photoshopped a picture of a road into a river. The biggest thing I wanted to bring up was the most common form of travel I have in the "Mall World" is through these weird ass inflatable airplanes. I don't know if they are actually inflated but they seem white, rubbery, and my brain translates what I see into inflatable. They work like regular planes and jets but the plane never seems to go too far off the ground and you can feel all the momentum from the lift-off, flight, and landing. I've flown in regular planes and they don't feel like regular planes. I was wondering if anyone else has traveled outside the "Mall World" area and encountered these weird highways or inflatable airplanes?
